description:
Implement the compile error format decided in "What does a good kernel compile error look like?" (defk-dtw.8; prototype on branch prototype/compile-errors, style D).

- One template for every rejection: Elixir diagnostic frame with file:line:col and a caret under the whole construct, then `why:`, `hint:` (with a rewrite where one exists), and `(defk <code>: docs/language.md#<code>)`.
- Audit all 61 `err!` sites in lib/defk/compiler.ex against it; give each a stable slug code. Fix the weak ones: "unsupported expression in kernel: ..." (map and string literals currently report no line and echo `:a` / `"hello"`), "cannot match ...", "empty block".
- Name the Elixir construct as written; "not in the kernel subset" vs "not supported yet"; no ticket IDs in messages.
- Collect every rejection in a module (cap 10), suppressing errors caused by an earlier one.
- Each code's failing example and suggested rewrite become tests (the rewrite must compile).

Done when every err! site follows the template with a code, the six prototype cases print as style D, and the tests above pass.
title: Adopt the kernel compile error format
